title: Climate Shocks, Cyclones, and Economic Growth: Bridging the Micro-Macro Gap
abstract: Empirical analyses of climatic event impacts on growth, while critical for policy, have been slow to be incorporated into macroeconomic climate-economy models. This paper proposes a joint empirical-structural approach to bridge this gap for tropical cyclones. First, we review competing empirical approaches in a harmonized global dataset and through a theory lens. Second, we estimate cyclone impacts on structural determinants of growth (productivity, depreciation, fatalities) to quantify a stochastic growth model for 40 vulnerable countries and project welfare effects of climate-driven cyclone risk changes. Third, we compute cyclone impacts on the social cost of carbon in the seminal DICE model.
abstract_zh: 气候事件对经济增长影响的实证分析对政策至关重要，但其纳入宏观经济气候—经济模型的进程一直较为缓慢。本文提出了一种联合实证—结构的方法，以弥合热带气旋方面的这一缺口。首先，我们在统一的全球数据集中并从理论视角审视了相互竞争的实证方法。其次，我们估计了气旋对经济增长结构性决定因素（生产率、折旧、死亡人数）的影响，以构建40个脆弱国家的随机增长模型，并预测气候驱动的气旋风险变化所带来的福利效应。第三，我们在经典的DICE模型中计算了气旋对碳的社会成本的影响。

title: Do Battle With Insurance": Post-Hurricane Insurance Litigation in Southwest Louisiana
venue: RSF: The Russell Sage Foundation Journal of the Social Sciences
abstract: Property insurance is essential for hurricane recovery, yet timely and fair claims payouts are not guaranteed. Post-disaster litigation over denied or delayed claims is common but understudied in who sues and how this varies sociodemographically. Southwest Louisiana is well situated for such an analysis, where within two years after Hurricane Laura and Hurricane Delta hit the region in 2020, one in five federal civil litigation cases were filed, most regarding insurance. We collate 5,476 court records to geocode implicated properties and assess litigation patterns using property and sociodemographic data. We find litigation is 43 percent more likely in higher percent Black residential areas, with property value amplifying this disparity. Additionally, case duration is longer for residents in these areas, suggesting systemic procedural inequities. Our findings reveal how race, class, and geography relate to insurance litigation, a critical yet overlooked facet of procedural vulnerability that may contribute to inequitable disaster recovery outcomes in the United States.
abstract_zh: 财产保险对飓风后的恢复至关重要，然而，及时且公平的理赔支付并无保障。对被拒绝或延迟理赔提起的灾后诉讼十分常见，但对于谁会提起诉讼，以及这种情况如何因社会人口特征而异，相关研究仍然不足。路易斯安那州西南部非常适合开展此类分析：2020年飓风劳拉（Laura）和飓风德尔塔（Delta）先后袭击该地区，此后两年内，该地区一年级联邦民事诉讼案件中有五分之一是在此期间提起的，且大多与保险有关。我们整理了5,476份法院记录，对涉案房产进行地理编码，并利用财产和社会人口数据评估诉讼模式。我们发现，在黑人居民比例较高的住宅区，提起诉讼的可能性高出43%，而房产价值进一步放大了这一差距。此外，这些地区居民的案件审理时间更长，这表明存在系统性的程序不公。我们的研究结果揭示了种族、阶层和地理位置与保险诉讼之间的关系，这是程序性脆弱性中一个关键却被忽视的方面，可能导致美国灾后恢复结果的不平等。

title: Flooding, Housing Prices, and Insurance: Evidence from the United States
abstract: Flooding is one of the costliest natural disasters in the United States, and a major source of flood damage is to the residential housing stock. Given the value of housing, both as a major source of household wealth and to the residential mortgage market, a long-standing literature has examined how floods impact house prices and evaluated the protective role of flood insurance. In this review, we synthesize the literature examining the impact of flood risk and flood events on housing value. We also examine research themes in the US flood insurance market including the determinants of flood insurance demand, the impact of insurance on household decisions to manage flood risk, and emerging changes to watch in the public and private flood insurance markets. We then survey key data challenges and opportunities and conclude by examining who bears the flood risk in the US housing market. As climate change is expected to change future precipitation patterns and raise sea levels, flood risk and insurance will likely be even more important for housing markets in the future.
abstract_zh: 洪水是美国代价最为高昂的自然灾害之一，而住宅存量则是洪水损失的一大主要来源。鉴于住房既是家庭财富的主要来源，又是住宅抵押贷款市场的重要组成部分，长期以来，相关文献一直在考察洪水如何影响房价，并评估洪水保险的保护作用。在本综述中，我们梳理了有关洪水风险和洪水事件对住房价值影响的文献。我们还考察了美国洪水保险市场的研究主题，包括洪水保险需求的决定因素、保险对家庭管理洪水风险决策的影响，以及公共和私营洪水保险市场中值得关注的新变化。随后，我们梳理了关键的数据挑战与机遇，并通过考察美国住房市场中由谁承担洪水风险作为结论。随着气候变化预计将改变未来的降水格局并抬高海平面，洪水风险和保险对未来的住房市场可能将变得更加重要。

title: Weather Forecasts Become More Important for Reducing Mortality as the Climate Warms
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Climate change will increase the frequency and severity of extreme heat, which is a leading cause of weather-related mortality. We combine causal estimates of how temperature forecast accuracy affects mortality in the United States with expert projections of changes in forecast accuracy over the coming century. Our analysis shows that improving short-run temperature forecasts in line with central expert projections would reduce annual heat-related mortality by about 18% by 2100, saving thousands of lives per year. If investments in earth observation networks and weather models improve forecasts in line with optimistic expert projections, annual heat-related mortality would fall by around 25% by 2100. Improving forecasts facilitates adaptation to climate change, saving more lives when climate change is more severe.
abstract_zh: 气候变化将增加极端高温的频率与强度，而极端高温是与天气相关死亡的主要原因之一。我们将美国温度预报准确性如何影响死亡率的因果估计，与专家对未来一个世纪预报准确性变化的预测相结合。分析表明，若短期温度预报的改进符合专家的中位预测，到2100年每年与高温相关的死亡人数将减少约18%，每年可挽救数千条生命。若对地球观测网络和天气模型的投资使预报改进达到乐观专家预测的水平，到2100年每年与高温相关的死亡人数将减少约25%。改进预报有助于适应气候变化，且气候变化越严重，挽救的生命也越多。

title: Operationalizing Cumulative Impacts for Policy
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy

title: Charting the Course: How Does Information about Sea Level Rise Affect the Willingness to Migrate?
Leveraging the Disagreement on Climate Change: Theory and Evidence
Creating Sustainable Flood Maps Using Machine Learning and Free Remote Sensing Data in Unmapped Areas
abstract: This study leverages a Random Forest model to predict flood hazard in Arizona, New Mexico, Colorado, and Utah, focusing on enhancing sustainability in flood management. Utilizing the National Flood Hazard Layer (NFHL), an intricate flood map of Arizona was generated, with the Random Forest Classification algorithm assessing flood hazard for each grid cell. Weather variable predictions from TerraClimate were integrated with NFHL classifications and Digital Elevation Model (DEM) analyses, providing a comprehensive understanding of flood dynamics. The research highlights the model’s capability to predict flood hazard in areas lacking NFHL classifications, thereby supporting sustainable flood management by elucidating weather’s influence on flood hazard. This approach aligns with sustainable development goals by aiding in resilient infrastructure design and informed urban planning, reducing the impact of floods on communities. Despite recognizing constraints such as input data precision and the model’s potential limitations in capturing complex variable interactions, the methodology offers a robust framework for flood hazard evaluation in other regions. Integrating diverse data sources, this study presents a valuable tool for decision-makers, supporting sustainable practices, and enhancing the resilience of vulnerable regions against flood hazards. This integrated approach underscores the potential of advanced modeling techniques in promoting sustainability in environmental hazard management.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用随机森林模型预测亚利桑那州、新墨西哥州、科罗拉多州和犹他州的洪水灾害，重点在于提升洪水管理的可持续性。利用国家洪水灾害图层（NFHL），我们生成了亚利桑那州的精细洪水地图，并以随机森林分类算法评估每个网格单元的洪水灾害程度。TerraClimate提供的天气变量预测值与NFHL分类结果以及数字高程模型（DEM）分析相结合，从而全面理解洪水的动态过程。研究表明，该模型能够预测缺乏NFHL分类地区的洪水灾害，从而通过阐明天气对洪水灾害的影响，支持可持续的洪水管理。该方法与可持续发展目标相契合，有助于设计具有韧性的基础设施和开展知情的城市规划，从而减轻洪水对社区的影响。尽管研究也承认输入数据精度的限制，以及模型在捕捉复杂变量相互作用方面可能存在的局限，但该方法为其他地区的洪水灾害评估提供了稳健的框架。通过整合多种数据来源，本研究为决策者提供了一种有价值的工具，支持可持续实践，并增强脆弱地区抵御洪水灾害的韧性。这一综合方法凸显了先进建模技术在促进环境灾害管理可持续性方面的潜力。

title: Cumulative Impacts in Environmental Justice: Insights from Economics and Policy
Earth Observation to Monitor and Redress Inequitable Post-Flood Recovery
abstract: Floods impact communities worldwide, resulting in an estimated $651 billion (USD) in damages, countless fatalities, and threatened livelihoods over the last two decades alone. Climate change and urban development in flood-prone areas will continue to worsen flood-related losses increasing the urgency for effective tools to monitor recovery. Many Earth Observation (EO) applications exist for flood-hazard monitoring and provide insights on location, timing, and extent in near real-time and historically to estimate flood risk. Less attention has been paid to flood recovery, even though differing recovery rates and outcomes can have immediate and enduring effects within communities. Here, we define post-flood recovery as a change in land cover types, conditions, or land surface features in the days, weeks, months, or years following a flood event. EO data are uniquely positioned to monitor post-flood recovery and inform policy on hazard mitigation and adaptation but remain underutilized. We urge the EO and flood research community to renew focus on developing flood recovery applications to address growing flood risk. Both methodological innovations and translation of EO insights on flood recovery among flood-affected communities and decision-makers are necessary to address underlying vulnerabilities in social systems that exacerbate flooding. We identify an unequivocal need for EO to move beyond hazard mapping to post-flood recovery monitoring to inform recovery across geographic contexts. This commentary proposes a framework to use EO to advance flood recovery monitoring, characterize inequitable recovery, redistribute resources to mitigate inequities, and support risk reduction of future floods.
abstract_zh: 过去二十年间，洪水在全球造成的损失估计高达6,510亿美元（美元）、无数人员死亡，并威胁着生计。气候变化以及洪水易发地区的城市开发，将继续加剧与洪水相关的损失，从而使有效的恢复监测工具变得愈加紧迫。针对洪水灾害监测，已有许多地球观测（EO）应用，它们能够近实时、并且在历史上提供洪水发生地点、时间和范围的信息，以估计洪水风险。然而，人们对洪水恢复关注较少，尽管不同的恢复速度和结果会对社区产生即时和持久的影响。在此，我们将灾后恢复定义为洪水事件发生后数日、数周、数月或数年间土地覆盖类型、状况或地表特征的变化。地球观测数据在监测灾后恢复、为减灾和适应政策提供信息方面具有独特优势，但其利用仍然不足。我们敦促地球观测和洪水研究界重新聚焦于开发洪水恢复应用，以应对日益增长的洪水风险。方法上的创新，以及将地球观测有关洪水恢复的成果转化为受灾社区和决策者可用的形式，对于解决加剧洪水灾害的社会系统中的潜在脆弱性都是必要的。我们明确指出，地球观测有必要从灾害测绘转向灾后恢复监测，以便为跨地理背景的恢复工作提供信息。本评论提出了一个框架，用以利用地球观测推进洪水恢复监测，刻画不平等的恢复状况，重新分配资源以缓解不平等，并支持未来洪水的风险削减。

title: Challenges in and Opportunities for International Collaboration: Costing Flood Damages and Losses across Canada, Mexico, and the United States
venue: Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society
abstract: Flooding, including inland and coastal flooding, is one of the most devastating and costly natural hazards in Canada, Mexico, and the United States. Recent research conducted by an international team has focused on understanding the true and comprehensive economic costs of floods, with an eye toward addressing their impacts, allocating adequate resources for monitoring and preparedness, and building resilient communities. Flood-costing methods vary greatly among federal and subnational jurisdictions across the three North American countries. Because the rigor and consistency of existing datasets across the three countries vary significantly, it is also difficult to determine the economic impacts of cross-border events. This paper aims to critically analyze the research methods used to conduct this trinational project and develop recommendations for enhancing impacts of such work in the future. We discuss three major research barriers: gaps in knowledge and research capacity, differences in data collation and analysis methods across the three countries, and linguistic barriers in working across disciplines and economic sectors. We also explore how the COVID-19 pandemic significantly added to these three barriers. We propose creation of new institutional mechanisms that can play a major role in developing comprehensive, consistent, and cohesive data gathering approaches in Canada, Mexico, and the United States.
abstract_zh: 包括内陆洪水和沿海洪水在内的洪水，是加拿大、墨西哥和美国最具破坏性、代价也最为高昂的自然灾害之一。一支国际团队近期开展的研究，着重于理解洪水真正而全面的经济成本，旨在应对洪水影响、为监测和防范配置充足资源，并建设具有韧性的社区。在北美三个国家的联邦和地方司法管辖区之间，洪水成本核算方法差异很大。由于三国现有数据集的严谨性和一致性存在显著差异，也很难确定跨境事件的经济影响。本文旨在批判性地分析用于开展这一三国合作项目的研究方法，并提出提升此类工作未来影响力的建议。我们讨论了三大研究障碍：知识和研究能力的缺口、三国在数据整理和分析方法上的差异，以及跨学科和跨经济部门合作中的语言障碍。我们还探讨了新冠疫情如何显著加剧了这三大障碍。我们提议建立新的制度机制，以在加拿大、墨西哥和美国开发全面、一致且有凝聚力的数据收集方法，这些机制可在其中发挥重要作用。

title: Stakeholder Opinions on the Issues of the Central Arizona Groundwater Replenishment District and Policy Alternatives
abstract: Arizona has been at the forefront of groundwater management since the establishment of the Groundwater Management Act in 1980. The Central Arizona Groundwater Replenishment District (CAGRD) is a groundwater management mechanism that facilitates development in regions of Central Arizona where the use of groundwater is limited by law. Several stakeholders have raised concerns about some of the CAGRD’s operations; however, stakeholders have yet to agree on the definition of the problems, let alone how the CAGRD might be improved. This study uses statistical and inductive thematic content analysis of a survey to determine (1) the CAGRD issues that stakeholders view as problems and (2) whether opinions differ significantly among different stakeholder groups. This study also uses deductive thematic content analysis to examine semi-structured interviews with CAGRD experts in order to find potential solutions to the CAGRD-related issues that are considered problems by stakeholders. The survey results show that long-term uncertainties related to the availability of renewable water supplies and hydrologic disconnect, where groundwater pumping and replenishment take place in different sub-basins, are stakeholders’ chief concerns. Sector affiliation and CAGRD membership status are associated with stakeholders’ opinions on some, but not all, questions. The potential policy changes offered address problems identified by stakeholders. This research will inform forthcoming policy discussions regarding groundwater management in Central Arizona as the state’s decision makers look to improve the CAGRD in the context of water scarcity exacerbated by climate change.
abstract_zh: 自1980年《地下水管理法》颁布以来，亚利桑那州一直处于地下水管理的前沿。中亚利桑那地下水补给区（CAGRD）是一种地下水管理机制，用于促进亚利桑那州中部地区的开发，而这些地区的地下水使用受到法律限制。若干利益相关方对CAGRD的部分运作方式提出了担忧；然而，利益相关方尚未就问题的界定达成一致，更遑论如何改进CAGRD。本研究运用统计分析和归纳式主题内容分析方法对一项调查进行分析，以确定（1）利益相关方认为存在问题的CAGRD相关议题，以及（2）不同利益相关群体的意见是否存在显著差异。本研究还运用演绎式主题内容分析方法，对与CAGRD专家进行的半结构化访谈进行分析，以寻找利益相关方认为存在问题的CAGRD相关议题的潜在解决方案。调查结果显示，利益相关方最主要的担忧是与可再生水供给的长期不确定性，以及抽水与补给发生在不同子流域之间的水文脱节有关。行业归属和CAGRD成员身份与利益相关方对某些问题（但并非全部问题）的看法相关。所提出的政策变革方案针对的是利益相关方所指出的问题。在气候变化加剧水资源短缺的背景下，随着亚利桑那州决策者寻求改进CAGRD，本研究将为即将展开的中亚利桑那地下水管理政策讨论提供参考。

title: A Comprehensive Methodology for Evaluating Economic Impacts of Floods: An Application to Canada, Mexico, and the United States
abstract: In 2020, we developed a comprehensive methodology (henceforth, the methodology) to assess flood-related economic costs. The methodology covers direct damages, indirect effects, and losses and additional costs across 105 social, infrastructure, economic, and emergency response indicators. As a companion paper, this study presents findings from analysis of applying the methodology to investigate economic costs for major flood events between 2013 and 2017 and to assess gaps in the existing datasets across Canada, Mexico, and the United States. In addition, we conducted one case study from each country for an in-depth examination of the applicability of the methodology. Applying the methodology, Mexico showed the most complete flood indicator data availability and accessibility among the three countries. We found that most flood-related economic cost assessments evaluated only direct damages, and indirect effect data were rarely included in datasets in the three countries. Moreover, few of the records from Canada and the United States captured the losses and additional costs. Flood-related economic cost data at the municipal or county level were easily accessible in Mexico and the United States. Mexico’s National Center for Prevention of Disasters (Centro Nacional de Prevención de Desastres), unique among the three nations, provided access to centralized and comprehensive flood cost data. In the United States and Canada, data collection by multiple agencies that focus on different jurisdictions and scales of flood damage complicated comprehensive data collection and led to incomplete economic cost assessments. Our analysis strongly suggests that countries should aim to expand the set of data indicators available and become more granular across space and time while maintaining data quality. This study provides significant insights about approaches for collating spatial, temporal, and outcome-specific localized flood economic costs and the major data gaps across the three countries.
abstract_zh: 2020年，我们制定了一套全面的方法论（以下简称“该方法论”），用于评估与洪水相关的经济成本。该方法论涵盖直接损失、间接影响，以及包括社会、基础设施、经济和应急响应在内的105项指标下的损失与额外成本。作为配套论文，本研究报告了应用该方法论分析2013年至2017年间重大洪水事件经济成本的结果，并评估了加拿大、墨西哥和美国现有数据集中的缺口。此外，我们对三国各开展了一项案例研究，以深入检验该方法论的适用性。应用该方法论后，墨西哥在三国中展现出最为完整、最易获取的洪水指标数据。我们发现，大多数与洪水相关的经济成本评估仅涵盖直接损失，而三国数据集中间接影响数据很少被纳入。此外，加拿大和美国的记录很少涵盖损失与额外成本。墨西哥和美国的市县层面洪水经济成本数据易于获取。墨西哥的国家灾害预防中心（Centro Nacional de Prevención de Desastres）在三国中独树一帜，提供了集中且全面的洪水成本数据访问渠道。在美国和加拿大，多个机构分别关注不同的管辖范围和洪水损失规模，这使得全面的数据收集变得复杂，并导致经济成本评估不完整。我们的分析有力地表明，各国应致力于扩大可用的数据指标集，并在保持数据质量的同时，在空间和时间上提高数据的精细程度。本研究为整理具有空间、时间和结果特异性的局地洪水经济成本方法，以及揭示三国之间的主要数据缺口，提供了重要见解。

title: Going Under Water? Flood Risk Belief Heterogeneity and Coastal Home Price Dynamics
abstract: How do climate risk beliefs affect coastal housing markets? This paper provides theoretical and empirical evidence. First, we build a dynamic housing market model and show that belief heterogeneity can reconcile the mixed empirical evidence on flood risk capitalization. Second, we implement a door-to-door survey in Rhode Island. We find significant flood risk underestimation and sorting based on flood risk beliefs and amenity values. Third, we quantify the model and estimate that coastal prices currently exceed fundamentals by around 13% in our benchmark setting, with the potential for significantly higher overvaluation in other areas. Finally, we quantify both allocative inefficiency and distributional consequences arising from flood risk misperceptions and flood insurance policy reform.
abstract_zh: 气候风险信念如何影响沿海住房市场？本文提供了理论和实证证据。首先，我们构建了一个动态住房市场模型，并表明信念异质性可以调和关于洪水风险资本化的相互矛盾的实证证据。其次，我们在罗德岛州实施了入户问卷调查。我们发现，人们存在显著的洪水风险低估现象，并且基于洪水风险信念和舒适性价值形成了分类集聚。第三，我们对模型进行了量化，估计在我们的基准设定下，沿海房价目前超出其基本面约13%，而在其他地区可能存在显著更高的高估。最后，我们量化了由洪水风险认知偏差以及洪水保险政策改革所引起的配置效率低下和分配后果。

title: Household Sorting as Adaptation to Hurricane Risk in the United States
abstract: We employ a structural model of location choice to estimate household sorting across the United States in response to hurricane risk. Using spatially detailed projections of future hurricane energy, we simulate regional population shifts and welfare effects of hurricane risk–induced migration in 2100. We find heterogeneous responses to hurricane risk for households that vary by number of children, age, educational attainment, and prior exposure to hurricane risk. Under future hurricane risk, although changes are small, we find declines in regional population shares along the hurricane-prone coasts and negative overall welfare effect. However, ignoring the spatial heterogeneity of hurricanes underestimates these effects. (JEL Q51, Q54)
abstract_zh: 我们运用一个区位选择结构模型，估计了美国家庭为应对飓风风险而进行的分类集聚。利用空间细化的未来飓风能量预测，我们模拟了2100年由飓风风险引发的迁移所导致的区域人口变化和福利效应。我们发现，家庭对飓风风险的反应因子女数量、年龄、教育程度以及既往飓风风险暴露而异。在未来飓风风险下，尽管变化幅度较小，但我们发现沿易受飓风侵袭的海岸线，区域人口份额有所下降，且总体福利效应为负。然而，忽略飓风的空间异质性会低估这些效应。（JEL Q51, Q54）

title: Risk Preferences and Natural Disasters: A Review of Theoretical and Empirical Themes

title: Institutional Design for a Complex Commons: Variations in the Design of Credible Commitments and the Provision of Public Goods
A Preference for Power: Willingness to Pay for Energy Reliability Versus Fuel Type in Vietnam
Developing a Comprehensive Methodology for Evaluating Economic Impacts of Floods in Canada, Mexico, and the United States
venue: International Journal of Disaster Risk Reduction
abstract: Assessing the true economic costs of floods is central to addressing their impacts, allocating adequate resources for monitoring and preparedness, assessing their changes over time, and building resilient communities. Considerable variability exists in the choice and implementation of methods used in Canada, Mexico, and the United States at national and sub-national levels for estimating the direct damages and indirect losses caused by floods. This inter- and intra-national variability leads to information gaps when prioritizing development investments, for example, for infrastructure renewal, institutional development, or community enhancements. This paper provides an overview of the range of approaches used in the three countries and analyzes their strengths and weaknesses. It then presents a proposed comprehensive and inclusive methodology that has been developed in close collaboration with a range of stakeholders and domain experts. This methodology builds on existing approaches and offers a comprehensive accounting of costs related to flooding. We offer insights into potential challenges for implementing this methodology across the three countries, particularly related to data availability, access, quality, and spatial coverage. We recommend enhanced gathering data and metadata, and storing it in an information warehouse for their timely dissemination. We also identify the need for further investigation into the definition for “extreme flooding” that incorporates hydrological, societal and economic thresholds, in collaboration between government agencies and the research community.
abstract_zh: 评估洪水的真实经济成本，是应对洪水影响、为监测和防范配置充足资源、评估其随时间变化以及建设具有韧性社区的核心。加拿大、墨西哥和美国在国家和地方层面估算洪水直接损害和间接损失所采用的方法选择和实施存在相当大的差异。这种国际间和国内的差异，导致在确定开发投资优先顺序时存在信息缺口，例如在基础设施更新、制度建设或社区改善方面。本文概述了三国所采用的各类方法，并分析了它们的优缺点。随后，本文提出了一种全面且包容的方法论，该方法论是与广泛的利益相关方和领域专家密切合作制定的。该方法论以现有方法为基础，对洪水相关成本提供了全面的核算。我们就在三国实施该方法论可能面临的挑战提出了见解，特别是在数据可得性、可获取性、质量和空间覆盖方面。我们建议加强数据和元数据的收集，并将其存入信息仓库，以便及时传播。我们还指出，需要进一步研究“极端洪水”的定义，该定义应纳入水文、社会和经济阈值，并由政府机构与研究界共同协作完成。

title: Flood Damage Assessments: Theory and Evidence from the United States
abstract: Flooding remains one of the globe’s most devastating natural hazards and a leading driver of natural disaster losses across many countries, including the United States. As such, a rich and growing literature aims to better understand, model, and assess flood losses. Several major theoretical and empirical themes emerge from the literature. Fundamental to the flood damage assessment literature are definitions of flood damage, including a typology of flood damage, such as direct and indirect losses. In addition, the literature theoretically and empirically assesses major determinants of flood damage including hydrological factors, measurement of the physical features in harm’s way, as well as understanding and modeling protective activities, such as flood risk mitigation and adaptation, that all co-determine the overall flood losses. From there, common methods to quantify flood damage take these factors as inputs, modeling hydrological risk, exposure, and vulnerability into quantifiable flood loss estimates through a flood damage function, and include both ex ante expected loss assessments and ex post event-specific analyses. To do so, high-quality data are key across all model steps and can be found across a variety of sources. Early 21st-century advancements in spatial data and remote sensing push the literature forward. While topics and themes apply more generally to flood damage across the globe, examples from the United States illustrate key topics. Understanding main themes and insights in this important research area is critical for researchers, policy-makers, and practitioners to better understand, utilize, and extend existing flood damage assessment literatures in order to lessen or even prevent future tragedy.
abstract_zh: 洪水仍然是全球最具破坏性的自然灾害之一，也是包括美国在内的许多国家自然灾害损失的主要驱动因素。因此，越来越多的文献致力于更好地理解、建模和评估洪水损失。洪水损害评估文献的几个主要理论和实证主题已经浮现。该领域的基础，是对洪水损害的定义，包括洪水损害的类型学，例如直接损失和间接损失。此外，文献从理论和实证上评估了洪水损害的主要决定因素，包括水文因素、对处于危险境地的物理特征的测量，以及对防护活动（如洪水风险减缓和适应）的理解与建模，这些因素共同决定了总体洪水损失。在此基础上，量化洪水损害的常用方法将上述因素作为输入，通过洪水损害函数，将水文风险、暴露度和脆弱性转化为可量化的洪水损失估计，并包括事前预期损失评估和事后事件特定分析。为此，高质量数据对于所有建模步骤都至关重要，而这些数据可从多种来源获得。21世纪初空间数据和遥感技术的进步，推动了该文献的发展。尽管这些主题和议题普遍适用于全球的洪水损害，但美国的例子能够说明关键议题。理解这一重要研究领域的主要主题和见解，对于研究人员、政策制定者和从业者更好地理解、利用并拓展现有洪水损害评估文献至关重要，从而减轻甚至防止未来的悲剧。

title: Sorting Over Flood Risk and Implications for Policy Reform
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Flood Risk and Salience: New Evidence from the Sunshine State
abstract:
A growing literature finds evidence that flood risk salience varies over time, spiking directly following a flood and then falling off individuals' cognitive radar in the following years. In this article, we provide new evidence of salience exploiting a hurricane cluster impacting Florida that was preceded and followed by periods of unusual calm. Utilizing residential property sales across the state from 2002 through 2012, our main estimate finds a salience impact of −8%, on average. The salience effect persists when we base estimation only on spatial variation in prices to limit confounding from other simultaneous changes due to shifting hedonic equilibria over time. These effects range from housing prices decreases of 5.4–12.3% depending on the year of sale. Understanding flood risk salience has important implications for flood insurance and disaster policy, the benefits transfer literature, and, more broadly, our understanding of natural disaster resilience.
JEL Classification: Q51, Q54, R21
abstract_zh:
越来越多的文献发现，洪水风险的显著性会随时间变化：洪水发生后显著性急剧上升，随后在接下来的几年里逐渐淡出人们的认知视野。在本文中，我们利用佛罗里达州一系列飓风事件（之前和之后都是异常平静的时期）提供了关于显著性的新证据。利用2002年至2012年全州的住宅房产交易数据，我们的主要估计显示，平均而言，显著性效应为−8%。当估计仅基于空间上的价格变异（以限制因随时间推移的特征价格均衡变化而带来的其他同期变化所造成的混杂）时，这一效应依然存在。根据交易年份的不同，这些效应对应的房价下降幅度为5.4%至12.3%。理解洪水风险的显著性，对洪水保险和灾害政策、效益转移文献，以及更广泛地对自然灾害韧性的理解，都具有重要意义。
JEL分类：Q51, Q54, R21

title: Global Tropical Cyclone Damages and Fatalities Under Climate Change: An Updated Assessment
Climate Costs of Tropical Cyclone Losses Depend Also on Rain
abstract: It is well established that climate change will lead to changes in tropical cyclone (TC) characteristics and affiliated impacts to human communities. While a growing social science literature estimates losses from TCs, almost all have characterized TCs by wind speed alone. However, TC winds are commonly accompanied by intense rainfall, both of which will likely be impacted by climate change. We assess the impact of rain on current and future TC losses and estimate the bias in loss calculations from omitting rainfall. Using a TC Integrated Assessment Model utilizing 60 000 simulated TCs making landfall in South Korea, we find rain to be a significant loss determinant. For both the wind-only and wind + rain cases, socioeconomic change will cause a decrease in fatalities and a large increase in property losses due to a shrinking population and growing wealth. Regarding climate change, the wind-only case considerably underestimates the climate costs of TC losses compared to the wind + rain case, driven by notable increases in future rainfall in contrast with minor wind intensity changes. While the relative impacts of TC wind versus rain under climate change will no doubt be different across countries, our results highlight the importance of accounting for both wind and rainfall in research and policy, especially in mitigation and adaptation planning.
abstract_zh: 气候变化将导致热带气旋（TC）特征发生变化，并对人类社区产生相应影响，这一点已得到充分确立。尽管越来越多的社会科学文献估计了热带气旋造成的损失，但几乎所有研究都仅以风速来刻画热带气旋。然而，热带气旋的大风通常伴随强降雨，而这两者都可能受到气候变化的影响。我们评估了降雨对当前和未来热带气旋损失的影响，并估计了在损失计算中忽略降雨所产生的偏差。利用一个热带气旋综合评估模型，并模拟了在韩国登陆的60,000个热带气旋，我们发现降雨是显著的损失决定因素。在仅考虑风力以及风雨同时考虑两种情形下，社会经济变化都将导致死亡人数下降，并因人口萎缩和财富增长而使财产损失大幅增加。就气候变化而言，与风雨同时考虑的情形相比，仅考虑风力的情形大大低估了热带气旋损失的气候成本，原因在于未来降雨显著增加，而风速变化则相对较小。尽管在不同国家，气候变化下热带气旋风力与降雨的相对影响无疑会有所不同，但我们的结果凸显了在研究和政策中，尤其是在减缓和适应规划中，同时考虑风力和降雨的重要性。

title: Is Tropical Cyclone Surge, Not Intensity, What Kills So Many People in South Asia?
Mediterranean Hurricanes and Associated Damage Estimates
abstract: Mediterranean hurricanes, or “medicanes”, are powerful cyclonic disturbances that cause wind, flooding, and surge damages around the Mediterranean region. Recent advancements in the natural sciences have improved historical understanding of medicane characteristics. Yet a systematic analysis of the economic impacts of medicanes has not been carried out. In this paper, we analyze 62 years of newly re-analyzed historical medicane tracks to characterize landfalls across space and time. We match historical landfalls with local socioeconomic characteristics. Using a cyclone damages function, we estimate historical medicane losses. We find that Italy suffers the highest expected damages from medicanes at $33 million dollars annually. Scaling by location size, Mediterranean islands are most at risk. We also present findings on landfall characteristics and calculate the return rate for storm damages. These findings are important for policy, especially with regard to the costs and benefits of long run adaptation.
abstract_zh: 地中海飓风，或称“地中海飓风”（medicanes），是强大的气旋性扰动，会在地中海地区造成大风、洪水和风暴潮等破坏。自然科学的最新进展改善了人们对地中海飓风特征的历史认识。然而，目前尚未对地中海飓风的经济影响进行系统分析。在本文中，我们分析了62年间新近重新分析的历史地中海飓风路径，以刻画其在空间和时间上的登陆特征。我们将历史登陆事件与当地社会经济特征进行匹配。利用气旋损害函数，我们估计了历史上地中海飓风造成的损失。我们发现，意大利因地中海飓风遭受的预期年均损失最高，达3,300万美元。按地点规模折算，地中海岛屿面临的风险最大。我们还给出了登陆特征的结果，并计算了风暴损害的重现率。这些发现对政策具有重要意义，尤其是对于长期适应的成本和收益。

title: Validating Resilience and Vulnerability Indices in the Context of Natural Disasters
abstract: Due to persistent and serious threats from natural disasters around the globe, many have turned to resilience and vulnerability research to guide disaster preparation, recovery, and adaptation decisions. In response, scholars and practitioners have put forth a variety of disaster indices, based on quantifiable metrics, to gauge levels of resilience and vulnerability. However, few indices are empirically validated using observed disaster impacts and, as a result, it is often unclear which index should be preferred for each decision at hand. Thus, we compare and empirically validate five of the top U.S. disaster indices, including three resilience indices and two vulnerability indices. We use observed disaster losses, fatalities, and disaster declarations from the southeastern United States to empirically validate each index. We find that disaster indices, though thoughtfully substantiated by literature and theoretically persuasive, are not all created equal. While four of the five indices perform as predicted in explaining damages, only three explain fatalities and only two explain disaster declarations as expected by theory. These results highlight the need for disaster indices to clearly state index objectives and structure underlying metrics to support validation of the results based on these goals. Further, policymakers should use index results carefully when developing regional policy or investing in resilience and vulnerability improvement projects.
abstract_zh: 由于自然灾害在全球范围内持续构成严重威胁，许多人转向韧性与脆弱性研究，以指导灾害防范、恢复和适应决策。为此，学者和实践者提出了多种基于可量化指标的灾害指数，用以衡量韧性和脆弱性水平。然而，很少有指数利用实际观测到的灾害影响进行实证检验，因此，在具体决策中往往不清楚应优先采用哪一种指数。为此，我们比较并实证检验了美国五个主要灾害指数，其中包括三个韧性指数和两个脆弱性指数。我们利用美国东南部地区观测到的灾害损失、死亡人数和灾害宣布数据，对每个指数进行实证检验。我们发现，灾害指数虽然有文献充分论证且理论上具有说服力，但其表现并不完全相同。五个指数中有四个能够按预期解释损失，但只有三个能解释死亡人数，只有两个能按理论预期解释灾害宣布。这些结果表明，灾害指数需要明确其目标，并构建支撑这些目标的基础指标结构，以便基于这些目标对结果进行验证。此外，决策者在制定区域政策或投资于韧性与脆弱性改善项目时，应谨慎使用指数结果。

title: Did Adaptation Strategies Work? High Fatalities from Tropical Cyclones in the North Indian Ocean and Future Vulnerability Under Global Warming
Risk and Adaptation: Evidence from Global Hurricane Damages and Fatalities
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We examine whether countries adapt to hurricanes. A spatially refined global tropical cyclone data set is created to test for adaptation. We find evidence of adaptation in most of the world by examining the effects of income, population density, and storm frequency on damage and fatalities. In contrast, there is no evidence of adaptation to damage in the United States, leading to a damage function which is 14 times higher than other developed (OECD) countries.
abstract_zh: 我们考察各国是否会适应飓风。我们构建了空间精细化的全球热带气旋数据集以检验适应性。通过考察收入、人口密度和风暴频率对损失和死亡人数的影响，我们发现世界上大部分地区都存在适应性。与此相反，美国不存在针对损失的适应性，这使其损失函数比其他发达国家（OECD）高出14倍。
